fields.title: Resolve occupancy expiry / 核对场地证明有效期
fields.notes: Ask custodian for the complete issued document; keep both dates. / 向保管人索取完整签发件，并保留双方日期。

fields.title: Obtain service permit original / 补服务许可原件
fields.notes: Request original from the document custodian. / 向保管人索取原件。

fields.title: Schedule fire inspection renewal / 预约消防续检
fields.notes: Confirm appointment and keep acknowledgement. / 确认预约并留存回执。

fields.title: Check business registration / 核对营业登记
fields.notes: Original and archive dates agree. / 原件与归档日期一致。
